title: Package not registered for the checked signing key
summary: The F-Droid APK for com.example.test is not registered for the signing key checked.
steps: Confirm the certificate used by the distributed F-Droid APK, then register that signing key for com.example.test when appropriate.
Where practical, work toward a reproducible distribution build so the published APK can carry the developer's own signing key.
Re-run the registration status check after the package and signing key are updated.
